target.title: fix(cli): strip reseed wrapper from imported CLI session messages
target.body:
Fixes #99646

## What Problem This Solves

Claude CLI users could see OpenClaw's internal reseed prompt and replayed history rendered as a user chat bubble after a fresh CLI session was seeded.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway now drops synthetic reseed rows instead of reconstructing a second user message. Fresh Claude CLI reseeds get a terminal marker only after all model-facing transforms and image decoration. A shared parser classifies marked, legacy, ambiguous, and ordinary text so visible history and fallback seeding make the same decision.

## User Impact

History clients show only the authoritative OpenClaw user turn. Internal replay scaffolding no longer appears or re-enters fallback context, while ordinary user text containing malformed marker-like bytes remains visible.

## Evidence

- Focused tests: parser 5/5, gateway history 92/92, execution 30/30.
- `oxfmt --check`, `oxlint --deny-warnings`, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Testbox `tbx_01kwnef5f3pj2jhwxwg5zk8khe`: `pnpm check:changed` passed for the core and core-tests lanes.
- Real importer scenario: `markedVisible=0`, `markedFallback=none`, `ordinaryVisible=1`.
- Local and whole-branch autoreview completed with no findings.
